title: Daily Market Digest: August 11, 2026
subtitle: Market closes lower as inflation data looms and oil prices rise

items.headline: U.S. Indices Close Lower Amid Geopolitical Tensions and Ahead of Key Inflation Data
items.summary: U.S. major indices finished in negative territory today, August 11, 2026, as investors weighed ongoing U.S.-Iran conflict and rising oil prices against anticipation for Wednesday's crucial CPI report. The market displayed a cautious sentiment, with broad declines despite some individual stock gains on strong earnings.

items.headline: National Energy Services Reunited Rises on Strong Earnings
items.summary: National Energy Services Reunited Corp. ($NESR) surged 23.3% today after reporting second-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings and total revenues that significantly beat analyst estimates.

items.headline: Auddia Sees Significant Gains
items.summary: Auddia ($AUUD) was among the top gainers, closing up 60.5% in today's trading session.

items.headline: Datadog Jumps on Revenue Growth
items.summary: Datadog ($DDOG) experienced an 11.5% increase today, supported by robust revenue growth of 31.5% over the past twelve months.

items.headline: Sionna Therapeutics Plunges
items.summary: Sionna Therapeutics ($SION) saw a dramatic decline, closing down 91.2% in an extreme move on a day where major indices were relatively flat.

items.headline: Coherent Leads S&P 500 Decliners
items.summary: Coherent ($COHR) was the biggest loser in the S&P 500, falling 14.2% today. The company trades at a high multiple of 131.9 times trailing earnings.

items.headline: Energy Sector Leads, Real Estate and Tech Lag
items.summary: The Energy Select Sector SPDR ($XLE) was a standout performer, rising 4.6% today. In contrast, Real Estate ($XLRE) fell 1.2%, Utilities ($XLU) declined 1.1%, and Information Technology ($XLK) also dropped 1.1%, indicating a rotation out of these sectors.

items.headline: CPI Report Awaited Amid Inflation Concerns
items.summary: Investors are closely watching for the release of July's Consumer Price Index (CPI) report on Wednesday, August 12, as expectations for a modest monthly increase could influence the Federal Reserve's policy direction. This follows a disappointing July jobs report, which showed non-farm payrolls dropped by 23,000 jobs, missing Wall Street expectations.

items.headline: Fed's Rate Path Under Scrutiny Following Mixed Economic Signals
items.summary: The Federal Reserve previously held interest rates steady, though three policymakers dissented for a rate hike, highlighting a divided stance. The market is now anticipating the FOMC will likely hold off on further rate hikes until at least December, especially after the latest jobs data.

items.headline: Oil Prices Surge on U.S.-Iran Tensions
items.summary: Oil prices continued their upward trend today, with West Texas Intermediate crude futures rising to $82.32 per barrel. This surge is attributed to heightened U.S.-Iran tensions and concerns over energy supplies, contributing to overall market cautiousness.

items.headline: Strong Q2 Earnings for S&P 500, Key Reports Today
items.summary: The second quarter of 2026 saw strong earnings growth for the S&P 500, with a blended growth rate of 47.4%, or 28.8% excluding Alphabet and Amazon. Today, companies like Cardinal Health ($CAH), CoreWeave ($CRWV), and Super Micro Computer ($SMCI) were scheduled to report earnings.
